# thunder_ddos_dst_zone_port_range_virtualhosts (Resource)

`thunder_ddos_dst_zone_port_range_virtualhosts`: Configure virtualhost based mitigation for SSL services

__PLACEHOLDER__



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `port_range_end` (String) PortRangeEnd
- `port_range_start` (String) PortRangeStart
- `protocol` (String) Protocol
- `vhosts_config` (String) 'configuration': configure virtualhost based mitigation for ssl services;
- `zone_name` (String) ZoneName

### Optional

- `source_tracking_all` (Number) enables creation of source entries for all virtualhosts
- `uuid` (String) uuid of the object
- `virtualhost_list` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--virtualhost_list))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--virtualhost_list"></a>
### Nested Schema for `virtualhost_list`

Required:

- `vhost` (String) name for virtualhost

Optional:

- `deny` (Number) Blacklist and Drop all incoming packets for protocol
- `glid_cfg` (Block List, Max: 1) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--virtualhost_list--glid_cfg))
- `level_list` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--virtualhost_list--level_list))
- `servername` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--virtualhost_list--servername))
- `servername_list` (String) Class List to match servername (Class List Name)
- `servername_match_any` (Number) Match when there is no SNI or other servernames are not matched
- `source_tracking` (String) 'follow': enable creation of source entries when source-tracking-all is enabled (default); 'enable': enable creation of source entries on this virtualhost; 'disable': disable creation of source entries on this virtualhost;
- `user_tag` (String) Customized tag
- `uuid` (String) uuid of the object

<a id="nestedblock--virtualhost_list--glid_cfg"></a>
### Nested Schema for `virtualhost_list.glid_cfg`

Optional:

- `glid` (String) Global limit ID
- `glid_action` (String) 'drop': Drop packets for glid exceed (Default); 'ignore': Do nothing for glid exceed;


<a id="nestedblock--virtualhost_list--level_list"></a>
### Nested Schema for `virtualhost_list.level_list`

Required:

- `level_num` (String) '0': Default policy level;

Optional:

- `src_default_glid` (String) Global limit ID
- `user_tag` (String) Customized tag
- `uuid` (String) uuid of the object

Optional:
